action.simulateHint: Run this level: send events, answer what the design leaves open, let time pass
action.nothing: Nothing on this level runs: it holds no state machine or flow

panel.label: Simulation
panel.guide: How simulation works (opens in a new tab)

start.title: Simulate
start.inputHint: The flow's vars.input, as JSON. Leave it empty to start without one.
start.startsAtInitials: Starts at each region's initial state.
start.startsAtEntry: Starts at {{entry}}, the other regions at their initial state.
start.startsFlow: Starts with one token at the start of the flow.

errors.integer: Write a whole number, such as 12
errors.datetime: Write a date and time such as 2026-01-05 09:00
errors.duration: Write a duration such as 2 days or PT2H
errors.object: Write a JSON object, such as {"expiresAt": "2026-01-15T09:00:00Z"}

errors.stuck: The run has nowhere to go
errors.noStart: The run has nowhere to start
errors.badInitial: The run's start is not clear
errors.dangling: The run reaches something that is gone
errors.badTarget: The run goes where it cannot
errors.notExecutable: This level does not run on its own
errors.internal: The simulator could not take this step

moves.title: What can happen
moves.none: Nothing is waiting for an event, a call or a timer.
moves.ended: The run has ended: what comes now changes nothing.
moves.stale: This run no longer matches the design. Start over to run it again.

payload.label: Payload of {{name}}
payload.empty: Leave it empty to send none.

time.label: Let time pass…
time.title: Let time pass
time.anyLabel: Or a duration, or a date and time
time.unreadable: Write a duration such as 2 days, or a date after the clock such as 2026-01-20 09:00

picker.label: Send an event or a call

steps.title: Steps
steps.shown: The run as it was after step {{step}} of {{count}}.
steps.shownStart_one: The run at its start, before its step.
steps.shownStart_other: The run at its start, before its {{count}} steps.

trace.restored: returns to {{state}}, as its history kept it
trace.endedSuccess: a token ends at {{at}}, in success
trace.endedFailure: a token ends at {{at}}, in failure

question.label: Question
question.count: How many items does {{name}} go through?

why.unwritten: Asked because these conditions have no expression.
why.failed: Asked because a condition could not be worked out.
why.case: Asked because its value cannot be worked out.
why.outcome: Asked because it has an error path: it may fail.
why.count: Asked because its items cannot be worked out.

marks.leftLabel: {{name}}, where the run was before this step

save.title: Save as scenario
save.description: Where the run started, each step's input and answers, and where each step got to are kept in the document, to be run again after the design changes.
save.name: Name
save.label: Save scenario {{name}}
save.readOnly: This tab is read-only: scenarios are saved in the tab that edits the project.

leave.restartTitle: Start over with steps not saved?
leave.description_one: This run has 1 step no scenario holds. Save it as a scenario, or discard it.
leave.description_other: This run has {{count}} steps no scenario holds. Save them as a scenario, or discard them.
leave.openTitle: Open the scenario with steps not saved?

accept.title: Accept the new path?
accept.description_one: From step {{step}} on, “{{name}}” records what the design does now. 1 later step can no longer be taken and is dropped.
accept.description_other: From step {{step}} on, “{{name}}” records what the design does now. {{count}} later steps can no longer be taken and are dropped.
accept.descriptionStart_one: From its start, “{{name}}” records what the design does now. 1 later step can no longer be taken and is dropped.
accept.descriptionStart_other: From its start, “{{name}}” records what the design does now. {{count}} later steps can no longer be taken and are dropped.
accept.label: Accept the new path at step {{step}}
accept.labelStart: Accept the new path at the start

diverged.label: goes elsewhere now
diverged.question: It now asks a question the recording does not answer.
diverged.answers: It no longer asks what the recording answered.

stage.label: Presenting {{name}}
stage.stopsAsking: The design no longer takes step {{step}}: it now asks “{{question}}”, which the recording does not answer.
stage.stopsFailing: The design no longer takes step {{step}}: {{message}}
stage.cannotStartAsking: The design can no longer start this scenario: it now asks “{{question}}”, which the recording does not answer.
stage.cannotStartFailing: The design can no longer start this scenario: {{message}}
